reason: Resolve implementation details that were intentionally described semantically in the preregistration. No outcome, candidate count by profitability, trade ledger or later-period value was inspected before this amendment.

realized_volatility.inputs: completed BTC and ETH hourly log returns only

clarifications.dvol_shock: Current completed-hour change in common DVOL standardized against prior completed hourly changes.
clarifications.event_clock: A candidate signal is emitted only on the first completed 5m bar on which its complete family mask changes from false to true. The mask must become false before a new event of the same candidate and asset can be emitted.
clarifications.four_asset_clock: Use the exact intersection of completed BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT five-minute opens. Any missing observation invalidates all rolling windows that include it; no forward fill, backfill or interpolation.
clarifications.development_start: 2022-04-04T00:00:00Z, after the registered four-asset gap boundary.
clarifications.tie_break: For signals sharing one entry timestamp, choose the highest registered score, then BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT.
clarifications.top_trade_removal: Remove the largest ceil(10% of N) positive account-return trades. If fewer positive trades exist, remove all positive trades; never remove losing trades in their place.
clarifications.funding_valuation: At each actual funding calc_time in (entry, exit], use exact same-timestamp mark-price open. Use exact contract open only when that mark open is absent and record each fallback.
clarifications.daily_metric: Geometric daily growth uses all UTC calendar days in the evaluation interval, including non-trading days.

unchanged: risk, leverage, participation and cost assumptions
